name: Tiled 2D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization
definition: A GPU-parallel rasterization method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that divides the image into tiles (default 32x32 pixels) to manage memory and processing load, assigning Gaussians to tiles based on their axis-aligned bounding boxes.
summary: Tiled 2D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization is a GPU-based rendering method that partitions the image into tiles to process millions of Gaussians in parallel, avoiding CPU sorting and enabling real-time performance.
